claim: The base model iPhone 15 features the A17 Pro processor and supports Apple Intelligence.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: Official Apple technical specifications confirm the base iPhone 15 features the A16 Bionic chip, whereas the A17 Pro is exclusive to the iPhone 15 Pro.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: iPhone 15 Chip: A16 Bionic chip with 6-core CPU and 5-core GPU.
iPhone 15 Pro Chip: A17 Pro chip with 6-core CPU and 6-core GPU.
